_note: Episode 42 (S5E1), story version 2 Kabanata 42. Present day; Usman present (in the present since Episode 30). Indio is President, past forty: new character string indio_s5 (grey at the temples, short beard), Usman, M, Sinag, Bakunawa and sarimanok strings reused from Episodes 13, 19, 29.
